description: inspire.govconnect.de: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire.govconnect.de. Coverage: the area served by inspire.govconnect.de. The listing groups 14 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Trinkwasserschutzgebiete - originär; Beim Wasserturm II (Ursprungsplan); Am Wasserturm (Kirchweyhe) (Ursprungsplan); Trinkwasserschutzzonen im Landkreis Ammerland. Formats seen: WMS, WFS, ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown), as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
